features.featureTitle: Remove the “Earned It — The Weeknd” song from the Valentine page by eliminating any Weeknd-specific labeling and not hardcoding the audio source to an “earned-it” file; keep the existing local-audio-only playback controls (play/pause, mute, volume) but make the UI copy generic so users can supply their own local audio file.

Add a small, simple corner image of the girlfriend using the user-uploaded photo, styled to be decorative and non-intrusive (e.g., small size, rounded corners/circle, subtle border/shadow), and ensure it appears consistently on both the initial and success screens without obstructing existing content or controls.
